#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Half : public std::pair<long long, long long> {
    using pair::pair;
    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
    long long match() const {
        return first;
    }

vector<vector<long long>> ways;

static bool nextCombination(vector<int>& a, int n) {
    int k = a.size();
    int ptr = k - 1;
    while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
        ptr--;
    }
    if (ptr < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    a[ptr]++;
    for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
        a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
    }
    return true;
}

long long choose(long long n, long long k) {
    if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) {
        return ways[n][k];
    }
    return 0;
}

long long getWins(const vector<char>& s, int r, int c) {
    int curA = 0;
    int curB = 0;
    long long ret = 0;
    for (char cc : s) {
        if (cc == 'A') {
            curA++;
        } else {
            ret += choose(curB, r - 1) * choose(curA, r);
            curB++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

bool testMask(int mask, int i) {
    return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
}

size_t maxSize = 64;
long long totalWays = 0;
long long bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
long long ans = 0;

struct F {
    long long bestDiffVal;
    long long answer;
    vector<vector<int>> cnt;
    long long maskA = 0, maskB = 0;
    vector<int> bufIdx;
    vector<char> buf;
    vector<H,h2> fst, snd;
    vector<int> sz;

    void preCalc() {
        ways.resize(61, vector<long long>(61,0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        long long totalValue = a.value() + b.value();
        long long diff = std::abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        long long delta = a.match() * b.match();
        if (diff < bestDiffVal) {
            bestDiffVal = diff;
            answer = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiffVal) {
            answer += delta;
        }
    }

    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        std::sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        int sz = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i].value() == arr[sz - 1].value()) {
                arr[sz - 1].match() += arr[i].match();
            } else {
                if (sz < arr.size()) arr[sz] = arr[i];
                sz++;
            }
        }
        arr.resize(sz);
        return arr;
    }

    bool test(int mask, int i) {
        return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
    }

    void solve() {
        int r = nextInt();
        int c = nextInt();
        string s = nextToken();

        bestDiffVal = LLONG_MAX;
        answer = 0;

        maskA = 0;
        maskB = 0;
        cnt.assign(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2,0));
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i + 1][0]++;
                maskA |= 1LL << i;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i + 1][1]++;
                maskB |= 1LL << i;
            }
        }

        long long lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
        long long lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

        int cPlusOne = c + 1;
        int totalMasks = 1 << cPlusOne;
        sz.resize(cPlusOne + 1);
        fst.resize(cPlusOne + 1);
        snd.resize(cPlusOne + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i <= cPlusOne; i++) {
            sz[i] = ways[cPlusOne][i];
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
            int compBtc = cPlusOne - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];

            // Build prefix computations
            int samePref = std::min(__builtin_ctz((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), cPlusOne);
            int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
            int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];

            if ((mask & 1) == 0) totalA += samePref;
            else totalB += samePref;

            long long winsA = 0;

            int curA = 0, curB = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i <= cPlusOne; i++) {
                if (testMask(mask, i)) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }

            int exactMatch = 1;
            for (int i = samePref; i <= cPlusOne; i++) {
                if ((!testMask(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') ||
                    (testMask(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A')) {
                    exactMatch = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }

            long long totalWaysLocal = choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch;

            fst[btc][idx] = {totalWaysLocal, winsA};

            int matchFlag = 1;
            if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) matchFlag = 0;
            if ((mask & lastA) != 0) matchFlag = 0;

            long long winsA2 = 0;
            int curA2 = btc;
            int curB2 = compBtc;
            for (int i = 0; i <= cPlusOne; i++) {
                if (testMask(mask, i)) {
                    winsA2 += ways[r - 1 + curB2][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA2, r);
                    curB2++;
                } else {
                    curA2++;
                }
            }
            snd[btc][idx] = {matchFlag, winsA2};
        }
        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        long long halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= cPlusOne; i++) {
            vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
            vector<Half> two = compress(snd[cPlusOne - i]);

            int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
            for (auto& a : one) {
                while (ptr >= 0 && a.value() + two[ptr].value() > halfTotal) {
                    ptr--;
                }
                if (ptr >= 0) update(a, two[ptr]);
                if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    void run() {
        solve();
    }

    static int nextInt() {
        int x; cin >> x; return x;
    }

    static string nextToken() {
        string s; cin >> s; return s;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    F solver;
    solver.preCalc();
    solver.run();
    cout << solver.answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
